correctness.rationale: RESULT.md lines 31–58 count ordered pairs over every odd finite field. In the basis H,E,F of sl₂, the trace pairing has tr(H²)=2 and tr(EF)=tr(FE)=1, hence is nondegenerate. A nonzero traceless A is nonscalar and cyclic, so its centralizer in M₂ is kI+kA and its traceless centralizer is kA. Thus im ad_A=A⊥. For nonzero C, q²−1 nonzero A are allowed, with q partners B each. For C=0 the matrix count is q³+q(q³−1). The vector map has image im A+im B and q^(4−r) lifts of every vector in it at rank r. At rank one the same image line ℓ lies in the kernel of each matrix by trace zero; both belong to the one-dimensional Hom(V/ℓ,ℓ), hence commute. For C=0 there are q²−1 nonzero matrix pairs on each ℓ, one rank-zero pair and q²(q²−1) rank-two pairs after subtraction. Combining vector lifts gives q³(q²−1) for C≠0, q³(q+1)(q²−1) for C=0,w≠0, and its sum with q⁶ for the zero target. Target counts and division by q^10 for the commuting probability follow. Inspected the packaged q=3,5 checker and output without executing it. Independent `python3 /workspace/replay/check_assignments.py 5` uses arithmetic in F₃[j]/(j²+1), direct matrix coordinates and image columns, including all 59,049 targets over F₉: (fiber size, multiplicity) = (58320,58968), (583200,80), (1114641,1). This confirms a nonprime-field case; the proof gives the universal result.

evidence: The mirabolic proof parameterizes all pairs with image in ℓ as rows (a,b),(c,d) in a basis starting with ℓ, with [A,B] having its sole possible nonzero entry ad−bc. The traces are exactly a and c. Imposing a=c=0 makes the commutator zero and leaves b,d arbitrary; removing (b,d)=(0,0) leaves precisely q²−1 pairs per ℓ.
The same proof supplies the rank-zero pair and q^(4−r) vector lifts, and sums rank-one contributions over the unique ℓ containing nonzero w, or over q+1 lines for w=0.
broader_coverage.reasoning: There are no rank-one pairs over C≠0, giving (G_q(C)/q²)q²=q³(q²−1). At C=0 subtract one and (q+1)(q²−1) from G_q(0)/q² to get q²(q²−1) rank-two pairs. Substituting into the prior rank-summation formulas yields both C=0 entries exactly. These substitutions cover all q, C and w in the frozen Finding.

evidence: For odd q, M₂=sl₂⊕kI. Adding scalar matrices to A,B does not change [A,B]; each ordered traceless matrix pair has exactly q² full matrix lifts. Thus the earlier mirabolic matrix totals G_q(Z)=q⁵−q³ for nonzero trace-zero Z and G_q(0)=q⁶+q⁵−q³ divide by q² in the restricted problem, before considering vector lifts.

The exact two-by-two traceless bracket existence statement for odd characteristic is cited in Stasinski, but existence alone is not the fiber law. The real special-affine A₅,₄₀ classification and Takiff sl₂ with a three-dimensional adjoint module are not equivalent fiber statements.
